en.html:
Finished.

I was finished.

Lowest of the low. Worst of the worst. Even my own company I could not bear. One person I could not get away from, and naturally that was the one person I needed to get away from.

Something else.

A dog, a cat.
A frog would do. An ant would do.

Anything. Just let me become something else. No need to make it a grand transformation. Nobody was asking for a tiger. One ant also, I would accept with gratitude.

Whatever it was, it would be an improvement on Kageaki Minato.

If a preference was allowed, a stone.

Ah.

A stone would be very good. No thoughts. No decisions. Lie there. Somebody kicks you, move a little. Again lie there. Such a sensible existence, and I had somehow ended up with this one instead.

I wanted to be a stone.

駄目だ。

　俺はもう駄目だ。

　最低、最悪だ。

　俺が俺に耐えられない。

　俺は俺である事が苦痛でならない。

　別の何かに。

　犬でも猫でも。
　蛙でも蟻でもいい。

　どんなものでもいいから変わりたい。

　どんなものでも湊斗景明よりは上等だ。

　願わくば、石がいい。

　ああ。

　石になりたい。

en.html:
For a crime, punishment.

For a man who broke the law, judgment by the law.

A very clear arrangement. Even I could understand it, and I was the fellow the arrangement was supposed to catch.

...So what was this law busy doing? Wrong man standing, wrong man waiting, wrong man himself wondering why the service was so poor.

en.html:
I was right here.

A man who had committed murder after murder, a man who ought to be judged, was standing right here. No difficult search was required. The criminal had brought himself. Head also attached, everything conveniently in one place.

Where had the law gone?

Why was it not judging me?

Why was this head still on my shoulders?

Some people said putting a criminal to death was wrong. Keep him alive. Make him atone. That was proper punishment. Achha, I could understand the reasoning. It was not beyond me.

But then the fellow needed some way to make amends. Otherwise you had merely kept a murderer in working condition. Breathing nicely. Walking also. Ask what had been repaired and everybody would start admiring the breathing again.

俺はここにいる。

　殺人の罪を重ねた、裁かれるべき男がここにいる。

　法はどうした。

　なぜ裁かない。

　なぜ、この首を刎ねないのだ。

　罪人を死罰に処すのは誤りであり、生かして償いを
させてこそ正しい処罰だと言う人間がいる。
　……その理屈もわからないではない。

　だがそれは、罪人が償いの方法を持っていなくては
成り立たぬ理屈だ。

en.html:
And what way did I have?

How was I to make amends now to the people these hands had killed? Or to the people who had died in the wars raging across the world—wars for which I could not even dream of denying responsibility?

No. Look at this cleverness. Already discussing how to clean up afterward, as though I had finished making the mess. Wah, Kageaki. First stop spilling, then give your great lecture on the cloth.

Wars deeply bound up with me were raging all over the world, and I merely watched. In Yamato, on the continent, in Europe—winds and rivers of blood. I could not stop them. Could not even work to keep more people from dying.

My hands were idle. Apparently that was not the same thing as clean. Sit perfectly still, do nothing at all, and somehow the killing continued to have my name on it. Such efficiency. If only I had ever been this useful at anything else.

It amounted to killing people even now. Going on killing them.

Hundreds. Thousands.

ja.html:
俺が、どうやって償える？

　この手で殺した人に、今更どう償うのだ。
　俺の責任無しとは夢だに言えぬ現世界各地の戦乱で
死んでいった人々に、どう償えるのだ。

　いや、償う以前の話だろう。
　俺は由縁浅からぬ世界中の戦禍をただ座視している。
大和の、大陸の、欧州の――血風血河を止め。せめて
これ以上人を死なせぬように働く事すらも、できない。

　俺は今現在も人を殺し、殺し続けているに等しい。
　何百人、何千人と。

en.html:
...Five hundred yen.

I was wondering why I had not been condemned, and this fellow had found me a reasonably priced afternoon.

Was that the difficulty? Had I mistaken the question entirely? Crime, punishment, one nearby talk, please bring change?

Nahin.

Why was I still not being condemned?

Why was I alive...?
